name: document_ocr
description: OCR and structured extraction for existing scanned documents and images through an optional self-hosted OVIS FastAPI service. Use action=ocr to recover page-attributed Markdown from scanned PDFs, PNG, JPEG, WebP, BMP, or TIFF files; action=extract to turn OCR text into instructed text, Markdown, or schema-validated JSON using the generation backend configured on the OVIS host; action=archive to save the service ZIP with OCR outputs and crops; or action=status to check health, readiness, GPU/model state, and capabilities. Accepts Jarvis Stash references or policy-approved local files and saves full outputs back to Stash by default so later Web UI turns can continue from bounded excerpts and artifact refs. Prefer pdf_read for born-digital PDF text, metadata, search, merge, split, and page rendering. Use document_ocr when the PDF is scanned/image-only, when an image contains substantial text, or when exact structured extraction is requested. The OCR stage remains local to OVIS; action=extract uses whatever text backend the OVIS administrator configured, such as local Ollama. It does not generate images and Jarvis never supplies that backend's credentials.

stash_ref.description: Input Stash URI such as stash://space_id/file_id. Use exactly one input source: stash_ref, space_id+file_id, or file_path.

space_id.description: Input Stash space ID when used with file_id.

file_id.description: Input Stash file ID or name when used with space_id.

file_path.description: Policy-approved local PDF or image path. Prefer stash_ref for Web UI uploads and do not combine this with another input source.

page_start.description: Optional first 1-indexed PDF page to process.

page_end.description: Optional last 1-indexed PDF page to process, inclusive.

keep_region_tags.description: Keep OVIS layout/region tags in OCR Markdown. Default true.

include_region_data.description: Ask OVIS to embed figure crops as Base64 data URLs in the full OCR JSON. Default false. Use only with a narrow page range; prefer action=archive for complete crop collections because Jarvis bounds JSON responses to 25 MB.

prompt.description: Required for action=extract. Instruction applied to the fixed OVIS OCR text by the generation backend configured on the OVIS host.

scope.description: For action=extract, apply the instruction to the whole document or separately per page. Default document.

response_format.description: For action=extract, requested output format. Use json with json_schema for strict structured extraction. Default text.

json_schema.description: Optional JSON Schema object for action=extract with response_format=json. Remote schema references are rejected by OVIS.

max_new_tokens.description: Optional output-token cap. For OCR it applies per OCR page. For extract it applies to each generation-backend call and the host may impose a lower per-call limit. With scope=page, selected page count multiplied by the effective value must fit the host's aggregate max_generate_request_tokens budget; use a narrow page range or lower value. action=status reports the active limits.

save_to_stash.description: Save complete OCR/extraction outputs to Stash. Default true. When false, only bounded inline excerpts and structured page results that fit the shared preview budget are returned; omitted content is not recoverable. Archive is always saved.

output_space_id.description: Optional existing Stash space for outputs; otherwise a new OCR space is created.

output_name.description: Optional safe base filename for saved OCR outputs.

availability.setup_hint: Set OVIS_OCR_URL to the root URL of a reachable OVIS FastAPI service in the active mode env file.
